description: Send a bug report, feature idea or other feedback to the Instadram team as you (same as Profile → Send Feedback). 10–5000 characters. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name: send_feedback
